snippet.title: Under The Red Sky (UTRS) - Steam Wishlist!
snippet.description:
*Steam (Steam Deck Compatible):* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870330/Under_The_Red_Sky/

Under the Red Sky is a fast-paced multiplayer 3D platformer where juicy momentum meets parkour movement in a crazy cocktail of fun. From running on walls, climbing any surface, jumping from wall to wall, boosting yourself to the skies - the players make their own path through the 84 handcrafted levels, featuring different visual and gameplay themes altogether.

Even though the setting of the game is super chill (with a great lo-fi soundtrack), the hidden parcels of Lore scattered in the game hint at a much darker truth.

You play as a nameless worker freshly employed by the infamous “Z-corp”, which we know very little about, but what we know isn’t great - your job is to run the levels of the game, and no one will tell you why. The more the player runs and interacts with other players, the more they’ll question what they do and try to stray from the “right” path.

This game is filled with secrets, hidden places, messages, and codes to decipher in the street art that populate the public hubs.

Whether you’re here to play for fun, to chill to good vibes music, try hard to beat your best times, speedrun, or uncover the hidden lore, UTRS has everything you need!

$7.99 regular pricing with 35% Launch Discount, so be sure to wishlist! 

*UTRS Credits:*
Federico Calchera (Lead Programmer, Game Designer, Artist)
Adam Meraihi - Dedra (Additional ****Programming, Level Designer)
Ossama Jouini - Dedra (Additional ****Programming, Game Designer)
Nicolas Nogueira - Dedra (Additional Art and 3D modelling/animating)
Credits to Erokia, Mount Blanc Candies and Marilyn Baumer (Dedra) for the soundtrack
Credits to Mikal and Armaldio for their tech help.

*About Dedragames*
We are a small group of 2 indie devs, an artist and a sound designer, scattered around the world but brought together because we love making games. Dedragames originally started as a long-awaited high-school dream of two friends living in France, willing to put everything on the line to live off of our passion of making games. While working on our first projects we’ve met Nico, our brazilian artist that we became very good friends with, and who introduced us to Meryl, would would become our amazing sound designer.

*More information:* https://www.dedragames.com

*About JumpButton Studio*

JumpButton Studio is a creative technology company building games and experiences that travel with you; across digital worlds and real ones. We blend culture, play, and storytelling to create impact-driven entertainment that connects people beyond the screen. Our work aims to transform how communities interact, compete, and create together.

*More information:* https://www.jumpbutton.com/
